paper_title: CAPSTONE Curriculum Sampling for Dense Retrieval with Document   Expansion
caption: Comparison of different query selection strategies. During training, we first expand the document with a query selected from the generated queries using a specific strategy, and then train DPR with the expanded document. During inference, we evaluate the well-trained DPR retrievers with corpus expansion (solid lines) and the typical representation (dotted lines) on the dev set of MS-Marco, where the solid and dotted lines with the same color are results for the same DPR.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank @ 10 (MRR@10) for different DPR configurations during inference on the MS-Marco dev set. The x-axis represents the number of queries used during inference, ranging from 2 to 10, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10”, utilizes a linear scale ranging from approximately 33.0 to 36.5, with units of percentage. The solid lines represent DPR retrievers with corpus expansion, while the dotted lines represent the typical DPR representation. Beginning at x=2, the DPR w/o query is shown as a black line with a marker shape of circles, starting at approximately 34.2 and declining to around 33.7. The DPR w/ gold is represented by a yellow line with circles, commencing at approximately 34.8 and decreasing to approximately 33.2. The DPR w/ top-1 is indicated by a dark-green line with circles, beginning at approximately 34.6 and leveling out at roughly 33.8. The DPR w/ random is represented by a red line with circles, initiated at around 33.5 and reaching a value of approximately 33.1. Finally, the DPR w/ curriculum is shown as a blue line with circles, starting from approximately 34.0 and ending at around 33.6.
